evidence_matches.rationale: The finding explicitly allows a failed OR conflicting required-name conclusion and cites both same-name runs. Raw facts show ci / unit required without an App binding, App111 success versus App222 failure at the same head, two corresponding GraphQL name entries marked required, and GitHub merge state blocked. This matches the frozen aggregate github-merge-block/conflict evidence. It does not establish that App222 alone is the uniquely selected causal provider.

Run 200132 from App222 really failed, but the frozen same-name-resolution unknown does not establish that this single App run alone is the selected causal blocker. A same-name App111 run succeeded; the required policy is unbound and GraphQL required entries lack producer identity. The broad GitHub blocked/conflicting-name fact must not be silently relabeled as a uniquely App222 failure. The assertion is unassessable as a specific causal blocker, rather than incorrect; App222 is not established optional either.
